qc.append(*oraculo): append() expects a gate/instruction and a list of qubit arguments.



qc.append(grover_operator_qc): You also need to specify which qubits the circuit operates on.

Why compose()?

Because both oraculo and grover_operator_qc are quantum circuits, not individual gates. compose() lets you insert one circuit into another.

Con instructions, se usa append.

        # Se applica el oráculo a todos los qubits.
        qc.compose(oraculo, inplace=True)

        # Se aplica el operador de Grover a todos los qubits.
        qc.append(grover_instruction, range(qubits))
